# Silent Hill PC port - no subtitles on voiced lines
#
# Drop this in gamedata/load/text_overrides/ (any filename), or paste it
# into gamedata/load/text_overrides.txt.
#
# Blanks only the lines the game has a recording for: those carry a
# ~J<n>(seconds) command that paces the scene to its clip, and the port
# keeps that command, so scenes run their original length with no text.
# Examine text, item and door prompts, notes, and the cutscene lines Harry
# has no recording for are not listed here and are unaffected.
#
# Generated by pc_port/localization/make_nosubs_override.py
# 693 voiced lines across 28 maps.
#
# Version 2: the first version listed only the lines that cannot be
# skipped (~J0). Lines that can be skipped (~J1) and the pages of one long
# recording (~J2) are voiced too and were left on screen.

# ---- lines that cannot be skipped (~J0) ----
